checks: Reviewed complete AccountSettings lifecycle and the resource hook. requestKey invalidation hides stale data synchronously; pending read blocks fresh account mutations, but a terminal read error does not imply an unknown account mutation.
Explicit login and logout recovery now use accountSettled in both DOM disabled state and imperative handler; authenticated usage still requires successful current account data.
Known device-login cancellation bypasses account-read readiness as before; current owner, connection, global admission, unresolved receipt, missing login identity and execution lock guards remain.
Read failures do not automatically mutate. Tests exercise failed-read login/logout, signed-out reread, held reads, unknown response recovery and existing missing-identity/owner guards.
limits: Independent code review and author targeted test verification; no duplicate full test or live account change.
